senses.definition_en: Swedish relay

examples.english: On Thursday at five in the afternoon, 100 and 600 meter sprints, long jumps, pole vaults, discus throw and hammer throw, finishing the championship with Swedish relay (400-300-200-100).
examples.ref: 1955 April 15, “Atletismo”, in Libertad, volume 25, number 5149, Valladolid, via Biblioteca Virtual de Prensa Histórica, archived from the original on 05 Oct 2025, Deportes, page 5:
examples.text: Jueves, a las cinco de la tarde, 100 y 600 metros lisos, saltos de longitud y con pértiga y lanzamiento de disco y martillo, para finalizar el campeonato con relevo sueco (400-300-200-100).
examples.translation: On Thursday at five in the afternoon, 100 and 600 meter sprints, long jumps, pole vaults, discus throw and hammer throw, finishing the championship with Swedish relay (400-300-200-100).

examples.english: One who also showed an amazing superiority was [Erwin] Skamral, also German, in the 200 m and the Swedish relay event, and not for nothing, as he is the current European record holder for the 400 m sprint.
examples.ref: 1986 September 13, Santiago Moreno Hernando, “Los españoles también saben ganar medallas”, in José Manuel Serrano Alvarez, editor, El diario de Ávila, number 27631, via Biblioteca Virtaul de Prensa Histórica, archived from the original on 05 Oct 2025, Deportes, page 10:
examples.text: El que mostró también una superioridad asombrosa fue el también alemán [Erwin] Skamral en los 200 m. y en la prueba del relevo sueco, porque no en vano es el recordman europeo actual de los 400 m.l.
examples.translation: One who also showed an amazing superiority was [Erwin] Skamral, also German, in the 200 m and the Swedish relay event, and not for nothing, as he is the current European record holder for the 400 m sprint.

examples.english: She [Ana Prieto] was already bronze at the Swedish relay in the European U18 Championships in Jerusalem (Israel), the same city that saw her earn a historic seventh place at the European U20 Championships.
examples.ref: 2024 August 19, Rubén Almagro, “Ana Prieto: Los Barrios se va de Mundial”, in Europa Sur, volume 36, number 12887, via PressReader, Deportes, page 39:
examples.text: [Saúl Sáez] [y]a fue bronce con el relevo sueco en el Europeo sub-18 de Jerusalem (Israel), la misma ciudad que le vio firmar una histórica séptima plaza el Campeonato de Europa sub-20.
examples.translation: She [Ana Prieto] was already bronze at the Swedish relay in the European U18 Championships in Jerusalem (Israel), the same city that saw her earn a historic seventh place at the European U20 Championships.
